### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing (independent of your proposed solution).

### Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and the proposed behavior.

### Affected Area

- [ ] Diagnostics
- [ ] Completion
- [ ] Hover
- [ ] Navigation (definition, references, symbols)
- [ ] Refactoring / code actions
- [ ] Formatting
- [ ] Editor client (VS Code or other)
- [ ] Other (please specify)

### Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered (including doing nothing).

### Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, or code examples about the feature request here.
